name: THE MANIFOLD ANNEX: Spire Private Betting Consortium
description: The Manifold Annex is the invitation-only successor operation to the older Manifold consortium, rebuilt after a 2218 membership scandal and now operating exclusively through sovereign-tier BCI channels accessible only to Tier 5 principals and their verified proxies. Members wager on a curated menu of high-consequence real-world outcomes — corponation hostile acquisition timelines, specific district destabilization events, individual political figure career terminations, and bespoke 'structured outcomes' where the consortium is alleged to have operational influence over the events being wagered upon. Minimum buy-in for membership is Φ500,000 annually, with individual position sizes reaching into the tens of millions.
story_hooks: A Tier 3 forensic accountant hired to audit a deceased Spire executive's estate discovers evidence of Annex membership and a position book showing a winning bet placed on an event that — according to the timestamp — was wagered on four hours before it was physically possible for the outcome to have been known.

An Annex proxy — a Tier 4 lawyer who places bets on behalf of an anonymous principal — has begun to suspect that the 'structured outcomes' her client bets on involve real operational harm to real people, and the Candor network wants her testimony but cannot guarantee her safety.

The Manifold Annex has opened a single invitation to a Tier 1 resident — a deliberate, publicized act of apparent charity that is almost certainly a trap, a test, or a message to someone else entirely.
